headline: Police arrest human trafficking suspect in Dhaka
summary: A suspected member of a Cambodia-based trafficking ring is in custody following an operation by the CTTC unit of the Dhaka Metropolitan Police.
details: The Counter Terrorism and Transnational Crime (CTTC) unit of the Dhaka Metropolitan Police (DMP) has arrested a man suspected of being part of a human trafficking ring operating in Cambodia.
The suspect, identified as Md. Shahadat Hossain, was apprehended during a raid in the Agargaon area of the capital on Wednesday evening.
According to the DMP, Shahadat is an accused person in a case filed at the Airport Police Station under the Prevention and Suppression of Human Trafficking and Migrant Smuggling Act.
Preliminary investigations suggest that the suspect was a key member of the trafficking network that lures victims to Cambodia.
Police have confirmed that legal proceedings against the arrested individual are currently underway.
caption:
A suspected member of a Cambodia-based human trafficking ring has been arrested in Dhaka.

The Counter Terrorism and Transnational Crime (CTTC) unit of the Dhaka Metropolitan Police (DMP) has arrested a man suspected of being part of a human trafficking ring operating in Cambodia.

The suspect, identified as Md. Shahadat Hossain, was apprehended during a raid in the Agargaon area of the capital on Wednesday evening.

According to the DMP, Shahadat is an accused person in a case filed at the Airport Police Station under the Prevention and Suppression of Human Trafficking and Migrant Smuggling Act.

Preliminary investigations suggest that the suspect was a key member of the trafficking network that lures victims to Cambodia.

Police have confirmed that legal proceedings against the arrested individual are currently underway.

Source: Dhaka Tribune, Prothom Alo

headline: 529 people arrested in Dhaka in 24 hours during police raids
summary: The Dhaka Metropolitan Police (DMP) filed 30 cases against the detainees across various police stations in the capital.
details: The Dhaka Metropolitan Police (DMP) arrested 529 individuals during regular operations across the capital within a 24-hour window.
The operations took place from midnight Tuesday to midnight Wednesday, according to a press release issued by the DMP on Thursday.
The arrests were distributed across several divisions: 133 in Mirpur, 83 in Wari, 67 in Tejgaon, 56 in Gulshan, 54 in Uttara, 53 in Motijheel, 39 in Lalbagh, and 35 in Ramna.
Additionally, 8 people were arrested by the Detective Branch and 1 by the Counter Terrorism and Transnational Crime (CTTC) unit.
Police recovered 100 grams of marijuana, 367 Yaba pills, two foreign pistols, three magazines, seven bullets, six mobile phones, and one switchgear knife from the detainees.
The DMP stated that legal proceedings against the arrested individuals are currently underway.
caption:
529 arrests in a single day. DMP raids sweep across Dhaka.

The Dhaka Metropolitan Police (DMP) arrested 529 individuals during regular operations across the capital within a 24-hour window.

The operations took place from midnight Tuesday to midnight Wednesday, according to a press release issued by the DMP on Thursday.

The arrests were distributed across several divisions: 133 in Mirpur, 83 in Wari, 67 in Tejgaon, 56 in Gulshan, 54 in Uttara, 53 in Motijheel, 39 in Lalbagh, and 35 in Ramna.

Additionally, 8 people were arrested by the Detective Branch and 1 by the Counter Terrorism and Transnational Crime (CTTC) unit.

Police recovered 100 grams of marijuana, 367 Yaba pills, two foreign pistols, three magazines, seven bullets, six mobile phones, and one switchgear knife from the detainees.

The DMP stated that legal proceedings against the arrested individuals are currently underway.

Source: Dhaka Tribune, Prothom Alo
